processes.title: U.S. Immigration & Visa Services
processes.summary: Classify the correct immigration or visa path before forms and fees: employment/family green card, adjustment vs consular processing, DS-160, H-1B/H-4, EAD, travel documents, permanent-resident services, naturalization, address changes and I-94.

processes.title: Family-Based Green Card
processes.summary: Classify the petitioner/relationship into immediate-relative or family-preference categories, then route Form I-130 to adjustment of status or NVC/consular processing without treating petition approval as permanent residence.

processes.title: Employment-Based Green Card
processes.summary: Run a stage-aware preflight from EB category and PERM/Schedule A classification through the immigrant petition, priority date/Visa Bulletin gate, I-485 adjustment or NVC/DS-260 consular processing.

processes.title: PERM Labor Certification Preflight
processes.summary: Validate the employer-side PERM sequence and timing: prevailing wage, 30–180-day recruitment calendar, Notice of Filing, ETA-9089, audits/supervised recruitment, certification or denial/review, and the 180-day I-140 handoff.

processes.title: Form I-140 Immigrant Petition Preflight
processes.summary: Validate I-140 classification, petitioner and labor route, category evidence, ability to pay, priority-date retention, premium processing, RFE/NOID handling and the I-485/NVC handoff.

processes.title: Employment-Based Form I-485 Preflight
processes.summary: Validate employment-based adjustment filing and pending-case gates: USCIS monthly filing chart, priority date, INA 245/245(k), I-693, Supplement J, I-765/I-131, derivatives, 180-day portability, notices/interview and Final Action availability.

processes.title: Employment-Based NVC / DS-260 Preflight
processes.summary: Validate the employment-based consular branch after I-140 approval: USCIS-to-NVC transfer, Visa Bulletin pre-processing and Final Action gates, CEAC fees, DS-260, civil/employment evidence, documentarily complete status, interview/medical, 221(g), immigrant visa and U.S. admission.

processes.title: U.S. Passport Services
processes.summary: Classify first-time adult, child, renewal, lost/stolen, damaged, correction, limited-validity and urgent-travel passport routes before choosing a form, appointment, or fee.

processes.title: Social Security Number & Card
processes.summary: Route first-time SSN, replacement card, legal-name change, record correction, citizenship/immigration update, child card and stolen-number cases to the correct SSA path and evidence set.

processes.title: IRS Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN)
processes.summary: Resolve SSN eligibility, new vs renewal Form W-7, tax-return vs documented-exception route, identity/foreign-status evidence, and mail/TAC/VITA/acceptance-agent submission options.

processes.title: Medicare Enrollment & Part B Timing
processes.summary: Classify Initial, job-coverage Special, exceptional Special, and General Enrollment paths; route Part B/CMS-40B/CMS-L564/CMS-10797 needs and avoid COBRA/retiree-coverage timing mistakes.

processes.title: Indian Passport Services in the U.S.
processes.summary: Classify the correct Indian passport or passport-related service before collecting documents: Fresh, Re-issue, Short Validity Passport renewal, Emergency Certificate, PCC, GEP verification, Surrender, Diplomatic/Official Passport, Identity Certificate, or passport appeal.

processes.title: Indian Passport Re-issue in the U.S.
processes.summary: Verify the correct Re-issue branch, jurisdiction, Tatkaal eligibility, fees, documents, Government-form selections and VFS alignment before submission.

processes.title: OCI Services in the U.S.
processes.summary: Planned OKF workflow for OCI registration, re-issue and miscellaneous OCI services.
